name: Startup Stash

sources.title: Add a Listing — page shell renders an embedded Typeform; contact Hello@startupstash.com
Where To Submit profile — submit path is an embedded Typeform, no confirmation, no published price
Operator email — 12-question form: product name, short desc (160 chars), long desc (500 chars), URL, category
Editorial policy — 'A paid listing does not buy a place on a shortlist'

requirements: Tool/resource relevant to startups — Startup Stash is a directory of tools and resources for entrepreneurs
Submission is an embedded Typeform at /add-listing/ (JS-required; the form does not render to plain fetches)
Third-party coverage describes ~12 questions: product name, short description (max 160 chars), long description (max 500 chars), product URL, category
No confirmation is sent after submitting — you wait for a reply by email
preparation: A monitored contact email — replies come back manually
workflow: Open https://startupstash.com/add-listing/ in a JS-capable browser
Alternatively email answers to Hello@startupstash.com — the operator has offered to fill the form for you
Wait for manual review; there is no automated confirmation or dashboard
If listed, the tool appears on the relevant category page under startupstash.com
watchFor: No visible price on the page — third parties report it as free, but confirm by email before planning
No post-submit confirmation; keep your own record of what you sent
A paid listing does NOT buy a place on their editorial 'Top Tools' shortlists — those are written independently
The Typeform may not render with aggressive script blocking
countsAsLive: Product appears on a Startup Stash category page with its description and outbound link
unknowns: Whether listing is currently free or paid
Whether the 12-question form is still the live intake (page last modified 2021 per schema data)
